descriptions.text: Upgrade Patch. Small. This upgrade patch depicts a traveling Reaper Spider Minion merchant. These guys are known for their sense of humor, and I highly recommend the first thing you do the next time you meet one is to insult them. They’ll love it. Affixing this patch to an eligible garment will imbue the following benefits: Access to the Midnight Market. Safety or Sanity not guaranteed. You will receive a notification if any traveling merchants are nearby. Plus 5% to Dexterity. Warning: Upgrade patches are fleeting items. You may remove them, but they will be destroyed in the process.

recap.text: Carl opens the Platinum Hell in a Handbasket Box and finds a small spider patch, which Donut calls Shi Maria and Carl calls a regular Reaper Spider Minion. Mordecai grunts that it opens a place Carl must stay out of, and Donut notes that telling Carl no never works. The black and silver patch grants Midnight Market access, a notice of traveling merchants, and five percent Dexterity, so Carl installs it.

beats.headline: A spider with baskets
beats.text: The Platinum Hell in a Handbasket Box holds a small patch of a spider. It's Shi Maria, Donut says; just a regular Reaper Spider Minion, says Carl. Mordecai grunts that it will give him access to a place he needs to stay out of, and Donut points out that telling Carl not to do something never works. Examined, it is black and silver, die cut in her horrifying shape but with a shorter neck and shorter hair, and wicker baskets lashed over the bulbous body. It grants access to the Midnight Market, a notice when traveling merchants are near, and five percent Dexterity. Carl is pretty sure the market is a bazaar hidden in the Desperado Club's bottom floor, and thanks to his Scavenger's Daughter, every patch he installs raises his stats, so this one should go on right away.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut open a box and find a spider patch that opens the Midnight Market.
